lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Birdie!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: You'd better watch your back today!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Today's a really weird day!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Even heroes don't see days like this very often!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: So you'd better be extra, extra careful, Birdie!
Why's that?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Today, I nearly tripped while walking down the street!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: But of course I didn't fall since I'm a hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I used my incredible heroic powers to catch myself at the last second!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: If I'd been a villain, I would've face-planted on the spot!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: That's not all!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: The restaurant I'd been planning to visit was closed!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Of all days, they just had to be closed today for personal reasons!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Do you know the agony of looking forward to something since yesterday, only to find out you can't have it?!
Yeah, I do.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: It's terribly tragic!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: But! I'm not sad!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I'm a hero, after all!
You're a true hero, Laplace!
You really are the strongestestestest hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Haha! I sure am!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: And there's one more thing!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Maxwell gave me an earful today too!
Doesn't that happen all the time?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Nope!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Sure, Maxwell nags me every now and then!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Normally, she would've let something like that slide,

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: but for some reason, she kept chewing me out today!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Three things that normally never happen all happened on the same day!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: But I'm the Ark's strongest hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Armed with heroic spirit and power,

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I overcame everything because I'm the strongestestestest hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: It would've been a rough day for any ordinary human!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: So, Birdie,

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: you'd better be careful too, just in case!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Today's a really weird day!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: If anything happens, just call for a hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: The strongestestestest hero is standing by!!
Haha, thanks. I'll be careful.
